29 ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT tenants by the entirety, having an address at 511 Tulfan Terrace, Bronx, NY 10463 (hereinafter referred to as "Owner") and Riverdale Realty Development LLC with an address c/o Simone Development Companies, 1250 Waters Place, Bronx, NY 10461 (hereinafter referred to as "Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the owner in fee title of a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in Bronx County, City and State of New York, known as Block 5796 Lot 160 and more particularly described in Exhibit A-1 annexed hereto and made a part of hereof (said land and tax lot being hereinafter referred to as "Owner's Land"; said buildings and improvements, if any, together with any future additions, alterations and replacements thereof being hereinafter referred to as "Owner's Building"; and said land and buildings and improvements being hereinafter referred to as "Owner's Property"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner in fee title of a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in Bronx County, City and State of New York, known as Block 5796 Lots 127, 154, 156, 157 and 159 and more particularly described in Exhibit A-2 annexed hereto and made a part hereof (saidland and tax lots being referred to herein as "Developer's Land"; and said land and buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof and any other adjacent land and buildings and improvements hereinafter acquired by Developer or any affiliates thereof, being hereinafter referred to as "Developer's Property"); Owner's Land and Developer's Land are herein sometimes jointly referred to as the "Parcels" WHEREAS, Developer intends, either through Developer or an affiliate thereof, to construct a new buiding(s) upon all or a portion of Developer's Land and, at Developer's option, on other adjacent land said new building(s), with any further additions, alterations and replacements thereof, being collectively herein called the "New Building"; WHEREAS, it is contemplated that the New Building will contain more floor area (herein referred to as "Floor Area"), as that term is defined in the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York effective December 15, 1961 (the "Zoning Resolution") than is now available for use under the "floor area ratio" limitation contained in the present Zoning Resolution related to Developer's Land as an independent "zoning lot", with the result that Developer desires to utilize the procedure available under the Zoning Resolution for combining Developer's Land and Owner's Land into a single "zoning lot" for the purpose of determining compliance by the New Buildingwith such limitation;
